explanation: The authority given by God to maintain order, punish evil, and reward righteousness.
The act in which a person voluntarily places themselves under the authority of those who have power over them.
Those who carry out God's will by serving society through their role in the civil structure.
The symbol of the state's right and duty to use force to enforce the law against injustice.
The financial contribution that citizens are obligated to give to the authorities as part of their civic responsibility.
A fee or tax on goods and services, which must also be paid according to the law.
What one owes to others, including financial obligations and moral duties toward fellow humans.
The highest form of righteousness where a person loves their neighbor as themselves, which fulfills the law completely.
